- **Common rust**: Raised, elongated pustules erupting from epidermis; darker orange, no yellow halo — doesn't match.
- **Southern rust**: Dense tiny orange pustules without distinct yellow halos; more uniformly orange — doesn't match.
- **Physoderma brown spot**: Tiny yellow dots in banded distribution; no orange centers — doesn't match.
- **Holcus spot**: Large white/tan irregular spots, few in number — doesn't match.
- **Carbonum leaf spot**: Large elongated oval lesions with concentric rings — doesn't match.

The characteristic "eye" morphology (dark center + yellow halo) is the defining feature of Eyespot (*Aureobasidium zeae*), and it matches the test image exactly.
